status: isolated native layout slice; verification evidence in handoff.json

contracts.behavior: Content is visible only when at least one relevant tab exists and content is not collapsed. Hiding does not close tabs.
contracts.native: WorkbenchSplitter holds has-content and persistent collapsed state separately; no browser is automatically recreated after last tab close.

contracts.behavior: Content preferred fraction starts at70%; chat minimum20%; filetree independently visible, source requested12% constrained by15% min/45% max and96px minimum.
contracts.native: Separate content/filetree preferences; 70%/15% effective defaults; native control minima and narrow adaptation described below.

contracts.behavior: Empty chat/history plus footer is vertically centered. Existing messages grow history to fill space and keep footer below. Footer max width768.
contracts.native: ChatSurface has centered bounded footer and switches history stretch only when projected rows exist; no fictional welcome content.

contracts.behavior: Transcript rows max width768 and remain centered independently of edge scrollbar.
contracts.native: ConversationView adjusts content margins by viewport width and app scale without rebuilding message widgets.

contracts.behavior: Top actions expose actual browser, terminal and filetree; hide/show uses existing-content toggle. Source Side chat is a real separate feature.
contracts.native: Browser/terminal/tree are functional; Side chat is omitted until implemented. Downloads/Git remain reachable through native actions.

contracts.behavior: Native shortcuts retain Ctrl+T, Ctrl+Alt+T, Ctrl+Alt+B, Ctrl+Shift+B, Ctrl+Shift+E and close current content with Ctrl+W.
contracts.native: QShortcut actions use existing tab/editor close guards.
Native window minimum matches; compact layout keeps navigation, composer and explicit content reachable.

contracts.behavior: Read label removes recognized mount prefix.
contracts.native: ws1 and w1 plus upstream short hex w prefixes display relative path; arbitrary ws19 remains unchanged.

nativeAdaptations: Below520 logical px the sidebar becomes a temporary navigation view; selecting/collapsing it returns workbench without changing desktop saved collapsed state.
Below520 logical px explicit content occupies the workbench; hide restores chat/filetree. Choosing Files restores the chat/filetree view. Tabs/processes remain alive.
Native controls reserve usable pixel minima in addition to source percentages. Final physical widths therefore differ at constrained sizes.
Explicitly opened browser focuses its address input; initial default tab is removed. Nonempty configured startup URL still opens a browser.
Scrollbar/content backgrounds are transparent after setWidget, preserving actual chatSurface colors instead of application Window color.
remainingGaps: No per-agent content-tab visibility/filtering/persistence; existing native tabs remain window-scoped.
No recent-workspace suggestion journal or source dismissal behavior.

Filetree is real read-only QFileSystemModel with editor opening, but source multi-workspace picker, Files/Diff tab, search UI, Git diff decorations and preview behavior are not supplied by this slice.
Side chat, source watcher/local-server popovers, exact divider/icon/hover animation geometry and source workspace chooser menu are not implemented here.
Existing workspace dropdown text includes a missing-font chevron in rendered fixture; this is recorded rather than claimed pixel identical.
No virtualized transcript or new markdown capabilities; existing transcript contract limits remain.
